title: Hollywood Video portable project archive manifest (hv-project-archive/1)
description: The archive.json entry of a portable project archive ZIP: one project, a sorted file inventory with byte counts and lowercase SHA-256 digests, and the total payload size. The schema is an in-repo contract validated by scripts/archive-package.py and packages/storage/src/archive-schema.ts with a bounded keyword subset; it is not published to any URL. Container limits (8 MiB manifest, 256 MiB state file, compression ratio 200) are enforced by the readers, not expressed here.
$comment: files.maxItems, bytes.maximum and totalBytes.maximum equal ARCHIVE_LIMITS in archive-schema.ts and MAX_FILES, MAX_FILE_BYTES, MAX_TOTAL_BYTES in archive-package.py; the conformance tests assert the equality. The path pattern is the safe_path character class [A-Za-z0-9_./-] split into non-empty slash-separated segments, so a leading, trailing or doubled slash is a schema violation; traversal segments and project/job ownership stay with safe_path and artifactKey.
